title: ARCADE: PLAYER 2 DROPS IN WITH A
why: His order of 2026-10-11, the 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO, build 6 of 20. Player 2 now joins with A on its own controller. If nobody is playing yet, player 1 window builds an arcade raid with player 1 benched (frozen, never hit, never a target) under the attract, which now reads PLAYER 1: PRESS ANY BUTTON, and player 2 drops in at a map spawn. Any press from player 1 brings him off the bench beside player 2. If player 1 is already playing, player 2 joins his raid in progress beside him, and the host hears PLAYER 2 JOINED. If player 1 raid was built before the link between the windows was up, player 1 gets a fresh raid on the same sector and keeps his score (PLAYER 2 JOINING). Player 2 never goes up without pressing A, never commits a packed kit, and keeps asking every few seconds until it is in. Normal co-op is exactly as it was.
now: Player 2 joins the arcade with A: player 1 waits on the bench until he presses a button.
